title: Briefings to Senate Intelligence Committee members and agencies

tellings.quote: to, you know, past members of Senate Select Intelligence Committee. I've provided it to uh numerous three-letter agencies. I've briefed them, given them the locations, the names, etc.

plain: A man named Jordan Jose, who says a secret UFO programme took him as a child, says that since about 2023 he has briefed past members of the Senate Select Intelligence Committee and "numerous three-letter agencies," handing over "the locations, the names, etc." He tells Michels this himself, in a story that touches on David Grusch, a former intelligence officer who testified to Congress about hidden UFO programmes. If true, it would mean officials have had his specific leads in hand.
